turns.patient_response:
Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I guess the main thing that pushed me to make an appointment is, well, it's probably not a huge deal, but I've been having a little trouble at work.

I'm not trying to slack off or anything, I promise! I just... I sort of end up wandering away from my desk when I shouldn't. I really want to do a good job there, so I figured I should probably ask someone about it. Is that... does that make sense to start with?
